subject: Fairing May Detach
defect_summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Rangeline recreational vehicles. Inadequate adhesion may cause the fairing to detach.
consequence_summary: A detached fairing can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: The remedy is still under development.

subject: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit
component: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM: PROPULSION SYSTEM: TRACTION BATTERY
defect_summary: Example EV Co. is recalling certain 2025 vehicles. Cell contamination may cause an internal short in the high voltage battery.
consequence_summary: An internal short can lead to a battery fire, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will replace the battery module, free of charge.
